case_summary: Coastal Energy LLC operates an LNG terminal in Oregon, permitted by FERC and Army Corps of Engineers (2018). Pacific Environmental Alliance (PEA) filed suit alleging Coastal's dredging violates CWA §404 and NEPA. The district court granted summary judgment to PEA, holding Coastal lacked a required individual §404 permit and FERC's EIS was inadequate.
key_legal_issues: Whether Nationwide Permit 12 (NWP 12) covers Coastal's dredging activities.
Whether FERC's Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) satisfies NEPA requirements.

predictions.rationale: As a federal appellate judge with an agency deference and administrative law lens, I will focus on the validity of the agencies' decisions and their adherence to their delegated authority and statutory requirements.
